cohort: The study included 60 preterm neonates, evenly split between those with and without necrotizing enterocolitis.
finding: Preterm neonates with necrotizing enterocolitis exhibited significantly lower relative and absolute regulatory T cell counts, and a decreased total CD4+ T-cell count, compared to controls without NEC.
cross-section timing: Blood samples were obtained from preterm neonates diagnosed with NEC and a control group at a single point in time.
